title: eval-harness: integrate per-prompt metrics into CI gating and add CI hook
author: Anika Shah
description:
Motivation: Add a lightweight CI hook that computes per-prompt evaluation metrics from the eval-harness and fails the build when configured quality gates are violated. This is intended to give teams early feedback on prompt-set regressions and to integrate eval metrics into the existing pipeline without adding heavy end-to-end jobs.

What this PR does: Adds a new CI hook (ci/hooks/prompt_metrics_hook.py) which: collects latest eval-harness results, computes per-prompt accuracy/emd/bleu (configurable list), compares values against thresholds declared in eval-harness/config/prompt_gates.yml, emits a compact summary to CI, and returns non-zero when any gate is violated. Adds a lightweight runner step to ci/pipelines/eval.yml to call the hook (with cached artifacts when available). Adds unit tests and example gate configs, and documents the feature in docs/eval-harness/ci.md.

Checklist: - [x] Hook implementation + CLI wrapper - [x] Config schema and example gates - [x] Unit tests for threshold logic and edge cases - [x] CI pipeline step wired into eval pipeline - [x] Docs and changelog entry - [x] Addressed reviewer feedback and flakiness in tests

Commits summary: 1) add prompt_metrics_hook and helpers; 2) add YAML gate config and schema validation; 3) add unit tests and fixtures; 4) wire CI pipeline step; 5) fix test flake (timeout) and update docs; 6) tighten default thresholds per ENG-6123 feedback.

Files changed (high-level): eval-harness/ci/hooks/prompt_metrics_hook.py (new) -- implements metrics extraction and gating; eval-harness/config/prompt_gates.yml (new) -- example gates and schema; ci/pipelines/eval.yml (modified) -- new step integration; docs/eval-harness/ci.md (new) -- docs and examples; tests/eval/test_prompt_gates.py (new) -- unit tests; eval-harness/core/metrics.py (modified) -- expose compact summary API; tools/ci_runner.py (modified) -- small wrapper to download artifacts.

Review & CI: Initial CI run failed on integration-tests due to a flaky fixture (test fixture timeout when creating temporary eval artifacts). I pushed a fix that reduces IO contention in the fixture and adds retries; re-ran CI and all checks passed. Reviewers requested clearer error messages when gates fail and a condensed CI log output; both addressed. Final reviewer approvals from Marco and Emma.

Merge: Squash-merged to main after approvals. Release notes: "Eval harness: add configurable per-prompt CI gating hook (ENG-6123) — teams can enable per-prompt quality gates to fail CI on regressions; see docs/eval-harness/ci.md."

notes: This is intentionally conservative: the default example gates use permissive thresholds; teams should tighten thresholds for their critical prompts. The hook reads latest eval artifacts from the CI artifact store; when artifacts are missing it exits with a non-failing warning mode unless CI is configured to treat warnings as failures.
